title: Shiv — Side Quest
description: Entertainment shelf: true crime, Why Files–style mystery, and comedy hangs (Brilliant Idiots, Flagrant, Conan when the guest is good). Not the intellectual Listen/Discover lane.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: Patrick Clancy’s 60 Minutes Interview & What Was Left Unsaid (Rotten Mango)
items.description:
Stephanie Soo breaks down Patrick Clancy’s CBS 60 Minutes interview with his new wife Rachel Danis — body language, the lines that went viral, and what the internet still won’t let go.

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/patrick-clancys-60-minutes-interview-what-was-left-unsaid/id1517954480?i=1000791900005

items.title: What Happened to the Godard Family? (Bedtime Stories)
items.description: A French doctor and his two children vanish on a 1999 sailing trip — then investigators find signs the story may have begun before the boat ever left shore.

items.title: Burned by a UFO: The Cash-Landrum Incident (The Why Files: Operation Podcast)
items.description:
The Why Files on the 1980 Cash-Landrum incident in East Texas: a diamond-shaped craft over a back road, military helicopters, radiation burns, and a lawsuit that never got a clean answer.

Watch: https://youtu.be/Rnldw4hUGoI

items.title: Joel McHale Returns (Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend)
items.description:
Conan O’Brien Needs a Friend with Joel McHale — a long-form comedy hang between two veterans who know how to keep a bit sharp without killing the guest.

Watch: https://youtu.be/ehda7OyjnuA

items.title: Private School Blues (The Brilliant Idiots)
items.description: The Brilliant Idiots on private-school anxiety and class signaling — Charlamagne and Andrew Banjo escalate, undercut, and reset status games as banter, not a seminar.

items.title: 179: The Courthouse - Revisited (Darknet Diaries)
items.description:
Darknet Diaries revisits an authorized pentest that ended in arrest — how scope, paperwork, and institutional panic rewrote a “legal” job after the fact.

Episode: https://darknetdiaries.com/episode/179/

items.title: Justin Gaethje on Cheating Allegations, Craziest DMs & Kicking Schulz (Flagrant)
items.description:
Flagrant with UFC’s Justin Gaethje: fight focus, glove drama, wild DMs, and parents’ impact — pure entertainment hang, not a true-crime procedural.

Watch: https://youtu.be/QHBVtakYbX0

items.title: Case 353: Jaidyn Leskie (Casefile True Crime)
items.description:
Casefile on the 1997 disappearance of Jaidyn Leskie in Moe — cold precision on a case where small-town folklore collided with forensic theater.

Episode: https://shows.acast.com/casefile-true-crime/episodes/case-353-jaidyn-leskie

items.title: MrBallen Explains What Dying in War Feels Like (Flagrant)
items.description:
Flagrant with MrBallen on what dying in war feels like — calm pacing inside a comedy room, dread landing harder because the hang keeps laughing around it.

Watch: https://youtu.be/gOvNZwm7ko0

items.title: The Basement: Brian Laythe | Ghosts, Possession, and Shadow People (The Why Files: Operation Podcast)
items.description:
The Why Files with Brian Laythe on ghosts, possession, and shadow people — haunt reports treated as data with selection effects, not vibes.

Watch: https://youtu.be/PWTYflbSoo4

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-basement-brian-laythe-ghosts-possession-and/id1631738803?i=1000790906676

items.title: MURDERED: Marina Ramos (Crime Junkie)
items.description: Crime Junkie on the murder of Marina Ramos — a case told as narrative pressure: what details survive, what gets buried, how the story keeps moving.

items.title: Toto Tartare (The Brilliant Idiots)
items.description:
The Brilliant Idiots dig into an AI researcher who quit Anthropic warning the industry is racing toward superintelligence — then spiral into culture-war comedy from there.

Watch: https://youtu.be/r-cjq6dH2QI

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/toto-tartare/id862717788?i=1000789090351

items.title: The Poltergeist Who Follows You Home (The Why Files: Operation Podcast)
items.description:
The Why Files on hitchhiker-effect cases: hauntings that witnesses say follow them home — eerie story engine, then the skeptic’s cut.

Watch: https://youtu.be/aKy38oc4D_I

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-poltergeist-who-follows-you-home/id1631738803?i=1000790588415

items.title: MYSTERIOUS DEATH OF: Lakesha Thompson (Crime Junkie)
items.description:
Crime Junkie on Lakesha Thompson’s 2023 death: investigators called it self-inflicted; the family says key evidence at the scene does not line up.

Watch: https://youtu.be/ouZsDx1IydM

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/mysterious-death-of-lakesha-thompson/id1322200189?i=1000788943569&uo=4

items.title: Bases in the Ocean, and a War for Earth | The Friendship Case (The Why Files: Operation Podcast)
items.description:
The Why Files on the Friendship Case — ocean bases, a war for Earth, and the usual mix of eerie source material and skeptical teardown.

Watch: https://youtu.be/M5xJnND9hDs

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/bases-in-the-ocean-and-a-war-for-earth-the-friendship-case/id1631738803?i=1000789191100
